insurer_name: Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Co. Ltd.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Covers 43+ Critical Illnesses (varies by plan: 10/20/43 CI variants). Lump-sum payout on diagnosis confirmed by specialist.
critical_illness_cover.notes: Major CIs covered: Cancer of specified severity, First Heart Attack, Open Chest CABG, Open Heart Valve Replacement/Repair, Coma, Kidney Failure requiring regular dialysis, Stroke, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Permanent Paralysis of Limbs, Motor Neurone Disease, Multiple Sclerosis, Third Degree Burns, Blindness, Benign Brain Tumor, End Stage Lung Failure, End Stage Liver Failure, Aplastic Anaemia, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease, Bacterial Meningitis, Loss of Speech, Loss of Limbs, Major Head Trauma, Primary Pulmonary Hypertension, Encephalitis, Apallic Syndrome, Cardiomyopathy, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with Lupus Nephritis

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Benefit / fixed-payout plan - no hospitalization indemnity

permanent_exclusions: Critical illness diagnosed within 90-day initial waiting period
Pre-existing CI / pre-existing diseases until 48-month waiting
Substance abuse, drug or alcohol intoxication
Tumors in presence of HIV infection
Cancer due to nuclear / war / chemical
notable_exclusions_summary: Fixed-benefit critical illness plan. Survival period: 30 days post-diagnosis required. Single payout on first qualifying CI diagnosis - policy terminates for that insured. Multi-pay option available on some variants. CI definitions per IRDAI standardization.
claim_process_summary: Submit diagnosis certificate from specialist medical practitioner, histopathology/imaging reports, claim form with bank details. Survival period of 30 days required. Lump-sum payment within 30 days of complete claim documentation.
